material_kit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: orthographic pixel-art material swatch kit for quiet Japanese fantasy ranch construction tiles. Exactly SIX rectangular textures on transparent margins in a tidy3columns x2rows grid, each flat rectangular swatch, no perspective, no building or scene. Top row compacted brown EARTH: left vertical rammed-earth wall front face with restrained stratum, middle seamless compacted-earth paving top distinguished from loose natural ground by pressed even pale ochre clay, right narrow rammed-earth wall top cap. Bottom row STONE: left rustic gray warm stone block wall frontface with staggered mortar, middle calm flat warmgray stone paving with broad simple stones, right narrow stonewall topcap. Rough proportions frontwall2:1, floor8:7, cap4:1. Flat limitedpalette, clean chunky pixel clusters, discrete2-3shades, upperleft light. Muted earth tan/brown and stone warmgray green undertone harmonize with wood, cream and calmgreen farm palette. No vegetation, scattered debris, glowingmagic, text, labels, numbers, characters, decorative props, groundshadow or white fringe. These are original source textures to be fitted into 48x42 logical game floor and 48x68 connected wall sprites; avoid tiny busy texture, photorealism, smooth gradients, outlines around individual tiles. Actual transparent outside6swatches. Wide generous gap between all swatches.
